title: Nana Patekar's late-night message & what doctors revealed about hours that followed
content: Actor Nana Patekar was declared dead after being brought to Manipal Hospital in Goa. He sent a message to a friend indicating he was unwell before losing consciousness. Friends and a caretaker accompanied him when he was taken to the hospital. Medical staff attempted to revive him for nearly an hour but declared him dead upon arrival. His body has been sent for a post-mortem examination following a medico-legal case.

title: Stock market crash: Sensex tanks 700 points, Nifty50 below 22,400 - key reasons
content: Stock market crash today:  At around 12:02 PM, Nifty50 was trading at 22,357.85, down 245 points or 1.08%. BSE Sensex was at 71,947.85, down 691 points or 0.95%. Sustained selling in large-caps by the FIIs have contributed significantly to this trend. With the US 10-year bond yield hovering above 5.3%, FIIs will continue to sell on every rally.

title: ‘True legend of Indian cinema’: Virat Kohli mourns Nana Patekar’s death
content: Virat Kohli expressed his condolences on social media after Nana Patekar's death due to cardiac arrest. Patekar was a prominent figure in Hindi and Marathi cinema, earning numerous accolades throughout his career. He made his mark with roles in films like Parinda and Prahar, and was awarded the Padma Shri in 2013. His recent works included Housefull 5 and O’Romeo, showcasing his enduring talent in the industry.

title: Mark Zuckerberg’s Biohub gets millions from Google, US govt to build virtual cells
content: Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan's nonprofit Biohub has secured fresh funding from Google DeepMind, Meta, Isomorphic Labs and the US government to build a "virtual cell", an AI model that predicts how human cells respond to disease and treatment. Total investment in the Virtual Biology Initiative now stands at $1.8 billion. Biohub expects its first open dataset in about a year, with accurate predictive models within the next five years.

title: Man gets leave encashment tax benefit, but limit hiked later; ITAT allows Rs 12.27L
content: The ITAT Chennai bench viewed the increase from Rs 3 lakh to Rs 25 lakh as an enhancement of an existing benefit, rather than the creation of a new exemption. The Tribunal also found the change beneficial and remedial in nature and said it was intended to reduce hardship and bring parity between government and non-government employees.

title: ‘So many have faded out’: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi cautioned with Vinod Kambli example
content: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi is making waves in the cricket world with his remarkable feats at an early age. However, cricket legend Kapil Dev advocates caution, emphasizing the volatile nature of youth talent. He stresses the significance of a player's growth beyond the cricket field for long-term success. In essence, the key question remains whether Sooryavanshi can sustain his performance consistently over the years.

title: Russia eyes return to Europe's gas market despite sanctions, Ukraine war: Report
content: Reports indicate that Russia is looking to reestablish gas supplies via the Nord Stream pipelines by negotiating with US investors, including Jared Kushner and a Russian adviser to Putin. This effort faces formidable challenges due to existing US and EU sanctions. Germany has taken a hard line against restoring gas imports while evaluating its military readiness regarding Russia. Additionally, the complexities surrounding gas ownership could impede any potential agreements.

title: Nevada’s 700-acre Shakespeare Ranch cuts asking price from $188m to $125m
content: Nevada’s historic Shakespeare Ranch, first listed for $188 million in 2024, is now asking $125 million after failing to find a buyer. The 700-acre Lake Tahoe estate features multiple homes, a 465-foot private pier and a barn built in 1873. Despite strong demand for luxury waterfront properties in the region, the ranch remains unsold.

title: East Hampton plans $36.3m buy of former sand mine to preserve 33.3 acres
content: East Hampton Town plans to acquire 38.3 acres of a former sand mine in Wainscott for $36.3 million. The purchase aims to preserve the land for parks and open space, reserving a smaller section for municipal needs. This decision marks a significant change from prior contentious commercial development proposals in the area. A public hearing is set for October 15 to allow residents to voice their opinions.

title: Priscilla Chan founded a school; 10 years later, Board votes to close it
content: Priscilla Chan's vision of a tuition-free educational environment for low-income families faced closure after a decade of significant funding. As the board made the difficult decision to shut down due to certain funding withdrawal, students found themselves with mixed academic results, some even excelling in literacy. With 540 students affected, the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative has stepped in to provide financial aid to families and local organizations in the aftermath.

title: Archaeologists drill 60 feet into Mount Ararat site in Noah’s Ark search
content: Archaeologists investigating Turkey’s Mount Ararat have drilled the boat-shaped Durupinar formation for the first time, collecting hundreds of soil samples from depths of up to 60 feet. Researchers are examining organic matter and possible traces of ancient wood for clues linked to Noah’s Ark, but laboratory analysis is still needed before drawing conclusions.

title: BJP turns heat on Rahul Gandhi over 'clash' with female Delhi cop
content: BJP leaders escalated attacks on Rahul Gandhi following his protests against the Election Commission. C R Kesavan accused Gandhi of inappropriate behavior toward a female police officer during the protest. Nitin Nabin labeled Gandhi as having an anarchist mindset and suggested he resign if he disagrees with the Election Commission. The Congress party has expressed demands for Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation over recent decisions.

title: ‘Play more cricket’: Kapil Dev’s blunt take on Hardik Pandya’s injury woes
content: Hardik Pandya's long absence from competitive cricket emphasizes ongoing concerns regarding player workload and fitness issues. Despite working towards a return, his recurring shin issue has delayed his comeback plans. Other players, including Prasidh Krishna and Harshit Rana, are also facing injury challenges affecting their participation. Former captain Kapil Dev pointed out the importance of playing regularly to maintain fitness levels.

title: US-based woman files case against parents for property share; Karnataka HC rejects it
content: The case involves a dispute over whether properties that had come to the woman’s father from her grandfather retained the character of ancestral property, giving her a right to seek partition under the Hindu Succession Act. The woman, based in the US, has been living abroad since her marriage in 1979. She filed a suit seeking partition of family properties and an equal share in them after her father sold one property.

title: Rahul, Priyanka Gandhi booked over 'assault' during anti-Gyanesh protest in Delhi
content: The Delhi Police have filed an FIR against Congress leaders Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi Vadra for allegedly assaulting police officers during a demonstration aimed at highlighting electoral roll discrepancies. The police complaint also mentions other party leaders and workers. Tensions increased when law enforcement intercepted demonstrators en route to Jantar Mantar, resulting in the detention of 91 individuals, including political figures and MPs.

title: 'Who knows about tomorrow': Nana Patekar's words at last public appearance
content: Nana Patekar died from a cardiac arrest shortly after an event in Goa, where he emphasized life's uncertainties. He encouraged attendees to serve others and live fully, stating that nothing is taken after death. Patekar was a prominent figure in theatre and cinema, recognized for his impactful performances in Hindi and Marathi films. Following his death, tributes poured in from across the country, highlighting his contributions to the arts.

title: How Shashi Tharoor left CJP's Saurav Das without a sting in the tail

Tharoor responded ambiguously, requesting clarification regarding the controversial metaphor he previously used. This interaction occurred against a backdrop of political tensions surrounding electoral roll revisions in Delhi. Opposition leaders, including Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi Vadra, were detained while protesting.

title: Florida mom rides 7,000 miles across 48 states, donates $17,560 to family support home
content: A Florida woman completed a 7,000-mile motorcycle journey across 48 states in six days. She raised $17,560 for Quantum House, an organization that supported her during her daughter’s hospital stay. The ride attracted attention, allowing her to create awareness about the organization. Jess's daughter, who benefitted from Quantum House, joined her when she presented the raised funds.

title: What is ‘enemy property’ and how is it identified? Allahabad high court explains
content: The Allahabad High Court made significant rulings on a property conflict in Muzaffarnagar concerning enemy and evacuee claims. The court determined that the state lacked substantial evidence to support its claims and highlighted the dismissal of prior complaints regarding the property. Consequently, it prohibited state officials from halting construction based on the approved map, thereby safeguarding the petitioners' property rights and ability to build.

title: 'If Shami is neglected, door will be closed': Ex-India star warns selectors
content: Bhuvneshwar Kumar’s return to the Indian team after a four-year gap has raised the possibility of another experienced pacer making his way back into the squad. Former India batter Wasim Jaffer believes Mohammed Shami deserves that opportunity, particularly in Test cricket. Shami has produced strong performances since returning from a long injury lay-off and has remained among the wickets across formats.

title: President Murmu, PM Modi hail IAF on Air Force Day
content: On October 8, the Indian Air Force marked its 94th anniversary, showcasing the unwavering commitment of its air warriors. In a ceremonial salute, President Droupadi Murmu and Prime Minister Narendra Modi paid tribute to their bravery and expertise that ensure the safety of the nation. Since its inception, the IAF has progressed notably, enhancing its strategic capabilities and modernizing its aircraft.

title: Rupee rises 10 paise against US dollar: What is supporting the currency?
content: The rupee opened at 96.71 against the dollar but improved to 96.65 thanks to intervention from the Reserve Bank of India. External factors, like a robust US dollar and climbing crude oil prices, are still putting pressure on the currency. Additionally, India's forex reserves are diminishing, leading to unease about the rupee's consistency.

title: Syria considers sending troops to Saudi Arabia to fight Houthis
content: Syria is considering military support for Saudi Arabia amid increased Houthi attacks on the kingdom. Discussions include potentially deploying troops as well as providing defensive expertise to combat the Houthi threat. Recent years have seen a strengthening of relations between Syria and Saudi Arabia, with new economic agreements established. However, Syria's priority remains its own recovery from a prolonged civil war.

title: ‘Cracks after quake’: Pregnant woman, 2 kids dead in Delhi building collapse
content: Three individuals, including two children, lost their lives when a building collapsed in Seemapuri, Delhi. Rescue teams responded promptly to the scene, searching for survivors and assisting the injured. Local residents reported that the structure had developed cracks after an earthquake a day earlier. The building reportedly belonged to the Delhi Urban Shelter Improvement Board and was around 20-25 years old.

title: Man beheads minor girlfriend in forest, dies in crash while fleeing
content: A 17-year-old girl was reported missing and found murdered in a forest in Madhya Pradesh. Ankit Malviya, her boyfriend, allegedly killed her after an argument, using a saw. He later called his cousin to confess before attempting suicide and colliding with a truck. Police discovered the girl's body and a saw at the scene, along with a rope noose.

title: 'Unko select karke koi meherbani nahi ki': Wasim on Bhuvneshwar's India return
content: Bhuvneshwar Kumar’s return to India’s T20I squad has received strong backing from former India batter Wasim Jaffer, who believes the experienced pacer’s selection is based on his performances and fitness, rather than any favour. Bhuvneshwar, 36, has been recalled for India’s five-match T20I series against New Zealand, beginning October 22. Jaffer feels the veteran seamer should have been brought back into the national setup earlier.

title: Some oligarchs blocking entry of Starlink in India: Elon Musk
content: Elon Musk has claimed that certain oligarchs are obstructing Starlink's entry into the Indian market. Starlink has already established the necessary infrastructure and is prepared to launch its services. The company aims to provide affordable broadband connectivity to areas lacking internet access. Regulatory approvals are awaited before the commercial rollout can commence in India. Collaboration with local telecom operators has been a key element in Starlink's strategy for success.

title: 'Stabbed 7 times': How bid to seal petrol pump turned deadly for IndianOil official

Swift action was taken by authorities, resulting in the arrest of five individuals, including members of the Pandavveer family. IndianOil and the petroleum ministry have rallied to support Shelke's family during this devastating period.

title: US to strike Iran? Pentagon orders military to gear up for attacks
content: The Pentagon has been instructed to prepare for possible military actions against Iran, amid stalled diplomatic efforts. Preparations may lead to attacks on Iranian nuclear facilities and strategic sites, although no attack timeline has been set. This situation overlaps with renewed fighting in Yemen, where Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia have intensified. Meanwhile, elections in the US and Israel may influence military decisions in the region.

title: IIT-B puts on hold 2026 rules on tough penalties for cheating

This decision follows the recent death of a student suspected of cheating during an exam. An interim procedure allows faculty to document suspected dishonesty while encouraging student accounts on a separate form. Faculty members and students will present their cases before a disciplinary committee after the examination period.

title: Oil remains beyond $100 per barrel as Middle East supply concerns persist
content: As tensions escalate in the Middle East, particularly around the Strait of Hormuz, oil prices have surged amid fears of potential supply disruptions. Recent assaults on tankers heighten the danger of transporting crude through this vital corridor. Additionally, American crude inventories are dwindling, signaling a tighter market, while diesel and jet fuel stocks remain below average levels, a trend seen for over seven months since the onset of regional conflict.
